about_the_game:
Good For Nothing is a cozy scavenger shop game where you explore dumpsters, storage units, and forgotten thrift stores to find hidden gems or total junk. Sell your finds, charm oddball customers, and turn garbage into gold, one questionable item at a time.

Gameplay

  • Scavenge items from various locations like trash bins, thrift stores, abandoned storage units, and more.

  • Bring your finds back to your shabby little shop, display them creatively, and sell to curious, eccentric customers.

  • Acquire money to upgrade your shop and abilities

Balance trash and treasure as you grow your humble junk stall into a thriving business built on society’s leftovers.

Features

  • Relaxing, feel-good progression

  • 3+ unique scavenging locations to explore

  • 50+ quirky and curious items to discover

  • Shop and ability upgrades

  • A short and sweet experience (~3 hrs of playtime)

  • Low-stress, high-vibe junk-hunting fun
